crossRefs.note: “Flee out of the middle of Babylon! Everyone save his own life! Don’t be cut off in her iniquity; for it is the time of…
“We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed. Forsake her, and let’s each go into his own country; for her…
You who have escaped the sword, go! Don’t stand still! Remember Yahweh from afar, and let Jerusalem come into your…
“Flee out of the middle of Babylon! Go out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the male goats before the flocks.
Leave Babylon! Flee from the Chaldeans! With a voice of singing announce this, tell it even to the end of the earth…
‘Come, Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon.’
Another, a second angel, followed, saying, “Babylon the great has fallen, which has made all the nations to drink of…
I heard another voice from heaven, saying, “Come out of her, my people, that you have no participation in her sins, and…
The men said to Lot, “Do you have anybody else here? Sons-in-law, your sons, your daughters, and whomever you have in…
He spoke to the congregation, saying, “Depart, please, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs…
With many other words he testified, and exhorted them, saying, “Save yourselves from this crooked generation!”
Therefore “ ‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.

translations.web: “My people, go away from the middle of her, and each of you save yourselves from Yahweh’s fierce anger.
translations.bsb: Come out of her, My people! Save your lives, each of you, from the fierce anger of the LORD.
translations.kjv: My people, go ye out of the midst of her, and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of the LORD.
translations.asv: My people, go ye out of the midst of her, and save yourselves every man from the fierce anger of Jehovah.
